Newspaper deck

Eyebrow, display headline, standfirst — the top of a column. The venue and price are absorbed into the standfirst sentence; the handoff link sits as a footer to the deck. The verdict reads like editorial, not a callout.

France v Mexico Group A · 14 Jun · 21:00 CET
The verdict — Pick

France look four points underpriced. Polymarket is the slower of the two markets.

Our score puts France at 68.5% to win the match; Polymarket has them at −180, an implied 64.3%. Kalshi is still at −151. If you're going to take a side, take the one with the better number.

Germany v Japan Group E · 22 Jun · 17:00 CET
The verdict — Avoid

Skip Germany–Japan. The line is short on both venues.

Both Kalshi and Polymarket are pricing Germany inside our number — the market reacted hard to Japan's friendly result, and the price moves have overshot what our model can defend. There's no second-best price to take, and no patience to be rewarded for waiting.

No venue handoff here — both sides sit short of our number. We'll revisit if Polymarket softens past 60%.
